spans.text: If tests cannot be run, explain why and provide manual validation steps.
spans.note: The prompt promotes truthfulness by requiring explicit verification of changes, summarizing root causes of failures, reporting coverage gaps, and explaining when tests cannot be run. This supports information integrity and honest reporting of uncertainty.

spans.text: Validate every change with explicit checks.
spans.note: The prompt promotes safe tool/action usage by requiring validation before broader actions, matching test depth to risk level, preferring deterministic tests, and establishing a graduated verification ladder that validates before proceeding.

spans.text: Prefer deterministic tests over flaky end-to-end checks.
